name: Sir Durgan Holdfast

feats.name: Toughness
feats.note: General. +1 Constitution and +1 Max HP per level (included)

weapons.name: +1 Warhammer (the clan weapon)
weapons.notes: Str 3 + BtH 2 + 1 magic. Magic weapon. Sunder: Advantage on Disarm and on checks to break objects. Crit: add 8. Charge: +6 with Advantage, 1d8+4; move up to 50ft in a straight line (at least 10ft). Declare before moving; one attack only. Attacks against you have Advantage until your next turn.

weapons.name: Throwing axe (Axe, Hand/Throwing)
weapons.notes: Thrown, so Strength applies to attack and damage. Light. Both axes take 1 slot.

personality: A grim Wall-veteran dwarf in plate who plants himself in the doorway and dares the enemy to try. Gruff, dutiful and fiercely protective; counts his allies after every fight and swears quietly until they are all accounted for. Left the Boldock Wall when his company was disbanded; the Keepers offered him a wall worth standing on: the people of Tariel.
inAFight: Wade in front, Challenge the biggest foe, open with Demoralise against a crowd (or Inspire if the party needs to hit), then hold the line so nothing reaches the casters.
abilitiesText:
**Demoralise (1/day, action).** Up to 25 enemies who can see and hear you: -6 to Charisma checks, and each makes a Will save (DC 13) or has Disadvantage on ALL its attack rolls for 5 rounds (Boldock Wall-Forged Dread). Only one of Inspire, Embolden or Demoralise can run at a time.

**Inspire (1/day, action).** All friendly creatures in your presence (up to 50) have Advantage on their first attack roll each round for 5 rounds. Cannot run alongside Embolden or Demoralise.

**Embolden (1/day, action).** Allies within 30ft gain +1 Fortitude, +1 Reflex and +2 Will saves for 5 rounds. Cannot run alongside Inspire or Demoralise.

**Challenge (1/encounter, part of an attack).** Name one foe within 30ft that can hear you. It makes a Will save (DC 13) or has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you for 1 minute. Saved or not, you have Advantage on your first attack roll each round against it for that minute.

**Birthright Mount.** You own a fully outfitted light warhorse (19 HP, war-trained). Mounted, its own attacks have Advantage. It waits at the dungeon mouth; horses do not do stairs.

**Horsemanship.** Ride, mount, dismount and control your horse in combat with no check. Cover, deflect, fall softly, leap and charge manoeuvres need a Dexterity check.

**Siege Discipline (kit).** Advantage on checks about fortifications, siege assessment, or coordinating soldiers in a defensive action (sizing up a barred door counts).

**Code of Conduct.** Courage, honour, loyalty, generosity, humility, faith, justice. Break it and you lose Inspire, Embolden and Demoralise until a sincere public atonement.

**Darkvision.** See in darkness out to 60ft as if it were normal light.

**Dwarven resilience.** Advantage on saves against poison; Resistance 5 to poison damage.

**Stonecunning.** Advantage on checks about stonework, underground construction or unusual stonework.

**Stonebraced (1/long rest).** Treat an incoming critical hit as a normal hit, or ignore being knocked down.

**Craft: Armourer.** Advantage on Armourer checks (free; not an NWP slot).

**The Clan Weapon.** Your +1 warhammer. Lose it and you have Disadvantage on Charisma checks with other dwarves until you recover it.

**Dul Khagul.** Advantage to identify clan lineage, weapon origin and traditions, and on saves against being charmed or persuaded against clan loyalty.

**Training.** Weapons: handaxe, battleaxe, warhammer, light crossbow, firearms. Armour: light, medium (the Knight adds all armour and shields).

**Brute Force (General).** +1 Strength (included). Advantage on Strength checks to break, force open or physically overpower an obstacle. A barred door is a Hard (DC 15) Strength check: you roll d20+3 with Advantage.

**Toughness (General).** +1 Constitution (included) and +1 Max HP per level (included). Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Speed, Initiative and HP.** Speed: 25ft (Dwarf; never reduced by armour or encumbrance) · Initiative: +0 · HP: d10: 1st level 10 + Con 3 = 13; levels 2-5: 4 x (6 + 3) = 36; Toughness +1 per level = +5. Total 54.
unsure: Charge is printed as its own row in the attacks table (+6 with Advantage, 1d8+4); folded into the +1 Warhammer notes rather than listed as a separate weapon.

name: Ilyra Fennwhisper

weapons.name: +1 Long Composite Bow
weapons.notes: Dex 3 + BtH 3 + 1 magic. Damage: bow 1d8+1, Dex +3, Bow Mastery +1, magic +1. Magic weapon. Crit: add 8. Twin Nock (two arrows): +7 / +7 (second at Disadvantage), 1d8+6 each, 110ft; your whole attack: two arrows at one or two targets. The +1 per-arrow bonus is the same +1 as Bow Mastery (they do not stack). No Running Shot Advantage on a Twin Nock turn. Fire Arrow: +7, 1d8+6 piercing + 1d6 fire, 110ft; ignites flammable material; fire keeps a troll from getting back up. Broadhead Arrow: +7, 1d8+6 piercing, 110ft; reduces the armour part of the target's AC by 2 for this shot.

gear.name: Arrows: 52 plain + 8 special (3 Fire, 3 Broadhead, 2 Rope)

personality: A restless wood-elf skirmisher who never stands still and always has the right arrow for the job. Light-hearted, impatient and competitive; keeps a running tally of her best shots and will tell you about them. Spent years tracking raiders on the edge of the Red Waste; joined the Keepers because they actually go after the people who go missing.
inAFight: Stay 30ft or more behind the front line; move 10ft and shoot for Advantage, or plant your feet and Twin Nock; Fire Arrows for the troll.
abilitiesText:
**Running Shot.** If you moved at least 10ft this turn before attacking with a bow, your first bow attack that turn has Advantage. Long Sight (kit): the trigger is also met, without moving, when the target is more than 60ft away.

**Twin Nock.** In place of your one attack, fire two arrows (one or two targets in range). The second arrow has Disadvantage. Each arrow deals +1 (does not stack with Bow Mastery). Cannot combine with Running Shot's Advantage on the same turn.

**Bow Mastery.** +1 damage with bows (included above).

**Bent Path (1/encounter).** One shot ignores the Disadvantage from Half Cover and reduces a shield's AC bonus by 2. Full Cover still blocks it.

**Arrow Repertoire.** Known: Fire Arrow (+1d6 fire, ignites), Broadhead Arrow (-2 to the target's armour AC), Rope Arrow (trails a 60ft line that anchors on a solid hit and can be climbed). You craft and carry up to 8 special arrows a day (Dex 3 + level 5), given materials.

**Skirmisher's Grace.** Difficult terrain costs no extra movement on a turn in which you end having made a ranged attack.

**Fletcher's Craft (Int).** Repair or craft bows, strings and arrows from available materials; identify odd or trapped arrows.

**Waste-Born Patience (kit).** Advantage on Survival checks to track a wounded target you have shot.

**Low-Light Vision.** Not darkvision: dim light counts as bright for you, and every light source reaches twice as far, but you see nothing in total darkness. Stay near the lantern.

**Keen Senses.** Advantage on Perception (sight or hearing) checks and on concentration saves.

**Fey mind.** Immune to magical sleep; Advantage on saves against charm.

**Trance.** A 4-hour trance replaces 8 hours of sleep.

**Saevren.** +5ft speed (included). Advantage on Stealth and Perception in natural environments. Camouflage (1/long rest): while moving through natural terrain, become undetectable to passive notice until you move or act.

**Training.** Weapons: longbow, shortbow, shortsword, handaxe. Armour: light.

**Steady Aim (Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks against a target engaged in melee with an ally. Shoot past the dwarf freely.

**Point-Blank Terror (Specialist).** No Disadvantage for making a ranged attack while an enemy is within 5ft of you.

**Speed, Initiative and HP.** Speed: 35ft (Saevren +5ft) · Initiative: +3 · HP: d8: 1st level 8 + Con 1 = 9; levels 2-5: 4 x (5 + 1) = 24. Total 33.
unsure: Twin Nock, Fire Arrow and Broadhead Arrow are printed as separate attack rows; folded into the +1 Long Composite Bow notes rather than listed as separate weapons.

name: Maud Hollins
acBreakdown: Mage Armour (cast each morning, 8 hours): 13 + 1 (Dex) + 1 (Ring of Protection) = 15. Without Mage Armour: 10 + 1 + 1 = 12.

feats.note: General, Human bonus. +2 Will saves and +1 Wisdom (included)

feats.name: Toughness
feats.note: General. +1 Constitution and +1 Max HP per level (included)

weapons.name: +1 Staff
weapons.notes: Str 0 + BtH 0 + 1 magic. Magic weapon. Versatile, Reach. Also her spellcasting focus.

weapons.name: Crossbow, Light
weapons.notes: Armour Piercing (ignores 2 points of armour AC). Fires once a round.

spells.slots: 3 cantrips at will; 1st- and 2nd-level slot counts not legible in the text extraction (includes the extra 2nd-level slot from Expanded Mind)
spells.notes:
Every spell is resolved by the target's save against your DC. Tick a slot box when you cast; slots return after a full rest. Cantrips are cast at will. Tick the circle beside a spell to mark it prepared. Prepare 8 spells each morning from the Witch list (level 5 + Wis 3); 3 cantrips always known. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield.

Toll the Dead (cantrip): 60ft, one creature: 2d4 necrotic, or 2d6 if it is already hurt. Will negates.

First Aid (cantrip): Touch: a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP, no roll.

Light (cantrip): Touch an object: bright light 20ft and dim light a further 20ft for 5 hours.

Mage Armour (1st): Touch, a willing creature in no armour: AC 13 + Dex for 8 hours. Cast it on yourself each morning.

Bless (reversible: Bane) (1st): 50ft, up to 6 allies, 1 minute: Advantage on their first attack each round and +1 to saves. Bane: up to 6 enemies get Disadvantage on their first attack each round and -1 to saves; Will negates.

Cure Light Wounds (reversible) (1st): Touch: heal 1d8+5 HP. Reversed: 1d8+5 necrotic, Fortitude halves.

Sleep (1st): 90ft, 15ft radius: roll 2d4+5; that many Levels of creatures fall Unconscious for 1d4 minutes, lowest Level first. Level 5+ creatures, undead and constructs are unaffected. Will negates. Damage wakes them.

Hex of Stumbling (1st): 30ft, one creature: speed halved for 1 minute. Reflex negates. Ideal for running from a troll.

Hold Person (2nd): 120ft, one humanoid: Paralysed for up to 5 rounds; it repeats the Will save at the end of each of its turns. Will negates.

Web (2nd): 60ft, 20ft cube, 50 minutes: creatures are Restrained (Reflex negates on first contact); escaping takes an action and a Strength check vs DC 15. Fire burns it away in 1 round, dealing 2d4 fire to everyone inside (Reflex half).

Bind Wound (2nd): Touch: heal 2d8+5 HP.

personality: A sharp-tongued hedge-witch who patches the party up and curses whatever is hurting them. Brisk, nosy and kind underneath it; scolds the wounded while she bandages them and talks to her toad more than to people. Mother Loretta says she owes the world a debt; Maud pays it off one rescued fool at a time, and the Keepers find her plenty of fools.
inAFight: Mage Armour every morning; Hex the most dangerous enemy, Sleep packs of goblins, Hold Person their leader, and keep a 2nd-level slot spare for Bind Wound.
abilitiesText:
**Hex (action).** Curse one creature within 30ft: Will save (DC 15) or it has Disadvantage on your choice of attack rolls, saves or ability checks for 1 minute (never on saves against the Hex). While hexed it takes 2d6 necrotic at the start of each of its turns and repeats the Will save at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success. One Hex at a time; a new one ends the old. 3 free Hexes a day (Wis mod), then each costs a 1st-level slot.

**Spell Use.** Prepare 8 spells each morning from the Witch list (level 5 + Wis 3); 3 cantrips always known. Slots refresh on a long rest. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield.

**Familiar: Pudding the toad.** 2 HP, AC 14. Acts on its own each round (move, scout, hide, carry small things) and shares what it sees and hears within 1 mile. Speaks a few simple words. If adjacent to a target it can deliver your Hex or a touch spell as your action. Re-bonded after a full rest if killed.

**Hag's Vigour.** +1 Max HP per Witch level (included).

**Patron Buff: Mother Loretta (1/day).** Tend a touched creature (or yourself) for 10 minutes: it regains HP as for one night in a safe haven (roll its largest Hit Die and add its Con mod, minimum 0). In combat, instead, as part of your action: it regains 1d8+2 HP.

**Human versatility.** +1 Wisdom and +1 Constitution (included).

**Chosen skill: Perception.** Advantage on Wisdom checks to notice things (no NWP slot).

**Bonus feat.** An extra General feat at 1st level (Will of Iron).

**Training.** Two extra weapons: light crossbow and short sword. Armour: light, medium (but a Witch still cannot cast in armour).

**No darkvision.** You need light. Cast Light on your staff.

**Will of Iron (General, Human bonus).** +2 to Will saves (included) and +1 Wisdom (included).

**Toughness (General).** +1 Constitution (included), +1 Max HP per level (included), Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Expanded Mind (Arcane & Devout).** One extra spell slot of your highest available level: a 2nd-level slot (included).

**First Aid/Healing (Trained).** Advantage to stabilise the dying.

**Speed, Initiative and HP.** Speed: 30ft · Initiative: +1 · HP: d6: 1st level 6 + Con 3 = 9; levels 2-5: 4 x (4 + 3) = 28; Hag's Vigour +1 per Witch level = +5; Toughness +1 per level = +5. Total 47.
unsure: Spell slot counts for 1st and 2nd level are printed as tick boxes and did not come through in the text; left out of the slots field.
Prepared-spell tick circles not readable; all 8 listed 1st/2nd-level spells put under prepared because they match her 8-spell preparation limit.
Ring of Protection +1 put in gear (not armour) as it is not armour or a shield; its +1 AC is in the AC breakdown.
Kit line prints 'Patron: Mother Loretta'; used for both kit and classNote.

name: Tibbet Quickfuse

feats.note: General. +1 Constitution and +1 Max HP per level (included)

weapons.name: Spark Caster (hand-built repeater)
weapons.notes: BtH 0 + Int 3. Counts as a magic weapon. Fires once a round. Only you can work it.

weapons.name: Fire Bomb (formula, brewed)
weapons.notes: No attack roll: pick a point. Fire keeps a troll down. All four take 1 slot.

weapons.name: Caustic Flask (formula, brewed)
weapons.notes: One target. Acid also keeps a troll down. Both take 1 slot.

weapons.name: +1 Dagger
weapons.notes: Finesse, Light. Dex 2 + BtH 0 + 1 magic. Magic weapon.

personality: A cheerful gnome alchemist with a bag full of bombs and a home-made zap-gun. Excitable, curious and slightly too fond of explosions; names every bomb and mourns each one a little as she throws it. Grew up in Tariel's workshops; joined the Keepers for the steady supply of interesting things to set on fire.
inAFight: Stay behind the knight; each turn throw a formula and fire the Spark Caster in the same action (Quick Hands). Save the Fire Bombs and Caustic Flasks for the troll.
abilitiesText:
**Quick Hands.** Using a formula (throwing or drinking it) can be part of your action: use one AND make one weapon attack (your Spark Caster) with the same action.

**Ingenuity Points: 8 a day.** Int 3 + level 5. Recover on a full rest. They pay for brewing.

**Brew Formula + Efficient Brewing.** In downtime, brew formulas you know for 1 Ingenuity Point each (bombs included). You can hold 8 brewed formulas (Int 3 + level 5); extras go inert. You start with 8 brewed.

**Known formulas (4).** Fire Bomb: thrown, 3d6 fire in a 10ft radius, Reflex DC 15 half. Caustic Flask: thrown at one target, Reflex DC 15 or 1d6 acid each round for 3 rounds. Elixir of Vigour: drink for 1d8+3 temporary HP. Smoke Powder Bomb: thrown, 15ft-radius obscuring cloud (attacks into or through it have Disadvantage).

**Spark Caster.** Ranged attack out to 60ft at +3, 1d8 force, counts as a magic weapon, once a round.

**Tinker's Craft (Int).** Build, repair, identify and jury-rig mechanisms and minor magic items: Int check +3, +2 class bonus. Needs your toolkit.

**Reliable Craft.** Any GM-adjudicated kit effect gives at least +1 to the check or save it affects, or at least 1d6 damage or healing.

**Small.** Small size: Advantage on Move Silently and stealth checks and on checks to escape a grapple or Restrained; Disadvantage on attacks with Heavy weapons. Darkvision 60ft; speed 25ft.

**Gnomish cunning.** Advantage on Will saves against magic.

**Chosen Expertise: Alchemy.** Advantage on Alchemy checks, and on building, repairing or identifying small mechanical devices.

**Puzzle-solver.** Advantage on Intelligence checks to solve a puzzle, riddle or mechanism under time pressure.

**Small and slippery.** Advantage on checks to hide or squeeze through tight spaces, despite encumbrance.

**Clever Fallback (1/long rest).** Reroll one failed Intelligence check (burn 1 Luck for a second use).

**Tariel Gnome.** Advantage on Charisma checks with human communities, and on trade, commission and small-business checks.

**Training.** Weapons: dagger, light hammer, hand crossbow, sling.

**Toughness (General).** +1 Constitution (included), +1 Max HP per level (included), Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Steady Aim (Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks against a target engaged in melee with an ally (Spark Caster and thrown daggers).

**Speed, Initiative and HP.** Speed: 25ft · Initiative: +2 · HP: d6: 1st level 6 + Con 2 = 8; levels 2-5: 4 x (4 + 2) = 24; Toughness +1 per level = +5. Total 37.
unsure: Spark Caster 'counts as a magic weapon' but has no printed +1, so magic is set to 0.
Fire Bombs and Caustic Flasks listed under weapons (they are on the attack table); Elixir of Vigour and Smoke Powder Bomb under gear.

personality: A quiet changeling knife who is never quite the same person twice and always strikes first. Polite, watchful and unreadable; answers questions with questions and never uses the same face two days running. On loan to the Keepers from the Veiled Ones' outer ring; the official reason is goodwill, the real one is that missing people are often somebody's secret.
inAFight: Win initiative and stab someone who has not acted yet; after that, fight next to an ally so your target is busy with them, then use Clean Hands to vanish.
abilitiesText:
**Sneak Attack (once per round).** Against an unsuspecting target you have Advantage on the attack and deal +3d6 (2d6 class + 1d6 Predator). Unsuspecting = it cannot see you, OR it has not acted yet this encounter, OR it is in melee with your ally and not with you. Works at range within 30ft; no Stealth check needed.

**Killer's Precision.** +1 damage on every weapon hit (included).

**Ambush Predator.** In the first round of combat, creatures that have not yet acted count as unsuspecting.

**Death Attack.** Study a target for 3 full rounds unseen (your action each round; ends if it sees you or you attack), then Sneak Attack it within 3 rounds while it cannot see you. If it takes damage: Fortitude save DC 16 or it dies; if it saves, the Sneak Attack dice deal maximum. Only works on a target of Level 7 or lower. A miss resets the study.

**Quiet Kill.** A creature you drop to 0 HP with a Sneak Attack falls silently; nobody nearby can notice it by sound.

**Poisoner's Edge.** Poison you apply lasts 3 hits instead of 1 and its DC is 2 higher. Your Blade Venom: on a hit, Fortitude DC 14 or 1d6 poison and Poisoned (Disadvantage on attacks and checks; poison damage at the start of each of its turns, 1d4 then 1d6, 1d8 and 1d10 where it stays; Fortitude DC 14 again at the end of each of its turns ends it). You never poison yourself applying it.

**Clean Hands (kit).** Once per encounter, after a Sneak Attack, Hide as part of the same action if cover or a crowd is within 10ft. Also Advantage to pass as someone who belongs somewhere and to pass on intelligence without a trace.

**Surveillance (kit).** Advantage on checks to tail or watch a target unnoticed.

**Assassin's Skills.** Checks with no NWP needed: Case Target (Wis), Climb at half speed (Dex), Disguise (Cha), Hide (Dex, even if only lightly obscured), Identify Poison (Int), Listen (Wis), Move Silently (Dex), Traps: find, disable, set (Int). Hide and Move Silently count as Stealth, so Predator gives them Advantage.

**Assassin's Skills, 3rd level.** +1 to saves against poison (Fortitude +4 vs poison). Hide and Move Silently can be attempted together, both at Disadvantage, at quarter speed. With alchemical equipment and raw materials you can make poisons and antitoxins for one-third of their street value, and you never risk poisoning yourself when applying poison to a blade.

**Darkvision.** See in darkness out to 60ft as if it were normal light.

**Shapechanger (action).** Change your appearance to any Medium humanoid; gear and clothes do not change. A hobgoblin face is an option.

**Perfect Mask (1/long rest).** Your current disguise is undetectable for one scene, even to magic (burn 1 Luck for a second use).

**Mimic.** Advantage on checks to imitate a voice or mannerism you have observed.

**Hard to fool.** Advantage on saves against being charmed, and on Insight checks to spot deception aimed at you.

**Predator (1st, Specialist).** Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included).

**Swift Reflexes (2nd, General).** Advantage on Initiative rolls, and +1 Dexterity (included).

**Speed, Initiative and HP.** Speed: 30ft · Initiative: +4 (roll with Advantage) · HP: d6: 1st level 6 + Con 1 = 7; levels 2-5: 4 x (4 + 1) = 20. Total 27.
unsure: Attribute block text was badly scrambled; Str 9 read from a fragment ('+39') and fits the +0 Str mod, while Dex 19 / Con 15 / Int 14 / Wis 11 / Cha 13 are confirmed by the AC, HP, save and weapon working.
Initiative is +4 rolled with Advantage (Swift Reflexes); stored as 4.
